purpose: Prepare the q3 RP-001/RP-002 governed repair lane for review by coupling annual insurance threshold operation coverage with A15 over-trigger prevention.
source_text_excerpt_policy: No long verbatim exam passages are embedded; official PDF evidence is cited by stable local source path and summarized.

official_source_evidence.question_source_summary: The official question gives two Zoohee health-insurance variants with monthly premiums and annual deductibles, then asks for the annual care-cost amount up to which the higher deductible is cheaper.
official_source_evidence.correction_model_summary: The correction model awards two points across annual-cost comparison and threshold conclusion. It accepts equivalent methods that compute EUR 1,684 for the statutory-risk maximum-cost comparison, EUR 1,035 annual premium for the higher-deductible variant, and the EUR 649 equal-cost threshold.

existing_governance_evidence.finding: q3-calc-1 is an operation_registry_need; A61 is source-reading support and A15 is stale/incorrect.
q3-answer-1 is an answer_skill_need for threshold-conclusion wording.
q3 A61 support with A15 rejected and q3 answer-skill visibility are preserved as routing facts.
EX_OP_ANNUAL_COST_THRESHOLD_COMPARISON and EX_ANS_THRESHOLD_CONCLUSION_UNIT_DIRECTION are named design candidates; candidate storage and writes are not authorized.
Dry-run candidate validation already requires A61 support and rejects A15 as q3 annual-threshold support.

operation_decomposition.answer_model_summary: Compute the statutory-risk annual maximum-cost comparison by combining twelve monthly premiums with the statutory deductible.
operation_decomposition.answer_form_hook: A96 covers bereken answer-form presentation but not the annual-threshold operation itself.
operation_decomposition.misconception_hook: Do not use only the lower monthly premium, and do not treat this as price elasticity.
operation_decomposition.scale_hook: Monthly-to-annual conversion is period conversion, not an exam table scale-factor such as x 1,000.
operation_decomposition.procedure_hook: A61 and A96 procedures are present; the annual-cost threshold operation remains the missing semantic unit/reviewed equivalent.

operation_decomposition.answer_model_summary: Compute the higher-deductible annual premium, derive the equal-cost threshold, and conclude that the higher deductible is cheaper up to EUR 649 per year.
operation_decomposition.answer_form_hook: A96 covers visible calculation answer form; threshold wording with direction remains a separate answer-skill need.
operation_decomposition.misconception_hook: The conclusion must preserve direction: higher deductible is cheaper only up to the threshold.
operation_decomposition.scale_hook: No incidence/pass-through or table-scale MTU is expected.
operation_decomposition.procedure_hook: The procedure must keep annual premium, deductible, threshold, and conclusion as a coherent chain.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Selects the table values needed for the calculation: correct insurance variant, monthly premium, annual deductible, and labels.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not itself model the annual-cost threshold comparison.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Covers bereken-vraag answer presentation: formula, substitution, intermediate steps, final answer, unit, and short conclusion.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not itself decide the domain-specific threshold operation or the direction wording.

unit_semantic_fit.rejection_reason: q3 has no price change / quantity change elasticity calculation, no elasticity interpretation, and no demand-elasticity route. It is an annual insurance cost threshold comparison.

dry_run_operation_candidate.output_expectation: Derive the annual care-cost threshold where the higher-deductible policy stops being cheaper, preserving euro-per-year units and direction.
required_steps: Select the correct monthly premium and deductible values for both variants.
Convert monthly premiums to annual premiums.
Combine annual premium and deductible/care-cost exposure into comparable annual totals.
State the threshold direction in context.

unit_support_assessments.rationale: A61 covers selecting correct table values before calculating.
A15 is price elasticity; q3 is not an elasticity calculation and has no price/quantity percentage-change route.
